## 3. In-Depth Project Architectural Breakdown

### Project A: CampusIQ — Smart Campus Event Management & Analytics Platform
- **Role**: Architect & Lead Developer
- **Domain**: University Administrative Systems, High-Concurrency Seat Allocation, Real-Time Analytics
- **Live Deployment**: https://campusiq-orpin.vercel.app/
- **Source Code**: https://github.com/param20h/campusiq
- **Stack**: Next.js 14 (App Router), TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, MongoDB Atlas (Replica Set 8.0), PyMongo 4.x, Python 3.14, Node.js Native MongoDB Driver (v6.x), Recharts, Pytest.
- **Architecture Highlights**:
  - **Two-Layer Segregation**: Layer 1 is a production web dashboard deployed to Vercel Edge; Layer 2 is an academic PyMongo offline testing and aggregation inspection CLI engine with zero production side effects.
  - **Concurrency Control & Zero-Overbooking**: Implements atomic single-document conditional updates via `$expr: {"$lt": ["$registeredCount", "$capacity"]}` combined with `$inc: {"registeredCount": 1}`. Completely eliminates race conditions and double-booking during seat rushes under WiredTiger without distributed locks.
  - **Indexing Strategy**: Follows the Equality-Sort-Range (ESR) rule on `events.{ status: 1, eventDate: 1 }` to eliminate in-memory sorting, along with compound unique indexes on `registrations.{ studentId: 1, eventId: 1 }` preventing duplicate registrations.
  - **Sub-10ms Aggregation Pipelines**: Multi-stage transformations ($match -> $lookup -> $unwind -> $group -> $project) compute department participation metrics and real-time occupancy percentages natively on Atlas.
  - **Testing**: 19 automated Pytest cases verifying index integrity, input validation boundaries, and write-blocking safety modes.

### Project B: ZenithFlow — Productivity & Wellness Ecosystem
- **Role**: Founder & Full-Stack Engineer
- **Domain**: High-Performance Personal Velocity SaaS, Habit Tracking, Biometric Coaching
- **Live Deployment**: https://zenithflow.dev/
- **Stack**: Next.js, TypeScript, Vanilla CSS, Supabase Auth, PostgreSQL with Row Level Security, Node.js, Express, Razorpay API, Resend API.
- **Architecture Highlights**:
  - Unifies daily velocity planning, hydration monitors, and physical workout logging with AI-driven biometric feedback loops.
  - Strict security posture leveraging PostgreSQL RLS ensuring tenant isolation at database level.
  - End-to-end payment processing lifecycle with Razorpay webhooks and transactional email confirmations via Resend.

### Project C: RAG PDF Assistant
- **Role**: AI Engineer
- **Domain**: Document Intelligence, Contextual Semantic Search, Multi-LLM Orchestration
- **Live Deployment**: https://pdf-assistant-rag.vercel.app/
- **Source Code**: https://github.com/param20h/PDF-Assistant-RAG
- **Stack**: Python, Flask, FAISS vector database, Sentence Transformers (`all-MiniLM-L6-v2`), Groq Llama 3 API, Google Gemini Pro.
- **Architecture Highlights**:
  - Ingestion pipeline parsing diverse formats (PDF, DOCX, TXT), chunking with token overlap, and generating embeddings stored in an in-memory FAISS index.
  - Sub-second vector similarity retrieval piped into context-augmented prompts for Groq and Gemini models.

### Project D: DeepFake Detector — AI Media Forensics System
- **Role**: ML Engineer & Full-Stack Developer
- **Domain**: Digital Media Authenticity, Computer Vision Forensics, Real-Time Browser Verification
- **Live Deployment**: https://deep-fake-mu.vercel.app/
- **Source Code**: https://github.com/param20h/Deep-Fake
- **Stack**: Next.js, TypeScript, FastAPI (Python), PyTorch, OpenCV, Chrome Extension (Manifest v3).
- **Architecture Highlights**:
  - Dual-interface system: a web dashboard for comprehensive video/image forensic diagnostics and a lightweight Chrome extension for instant one-click context menu image verification.
  - Convolutional neural network models inspecting facial artifact boundaries, frequency anomalies, and blending inconsistencies.

### Project E: Vesta AI — Investment Research Agent
- **Role**: AI Systems Architect
- **Domain**: Financial Analysis, Agentic Workflows, Real-Time Graph Traversal
- **Live Deployment**: https://ai-investment-planner-amber.vercel.app
- **Source Code**: https://github.com/param20h/Ai-investment-planner
- **Stack**: Next.js (App Router), TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, LangGraph.js, Google Gemini 2.5 Flash, Tavily Financial Search API, FMP (Financial Modeling Prep) API.
- **Architecture Highlights**:
  - 3-node deterministic agentic DAG: (1) Ticker Resolution & Live Market Retrieval -> (2) Structured Signal & Metric Extraction -> (3) Grounded Decision Synthesis.
  - Outputs a concrete Invest/Watch/Pass verdict accompanied by transparent risk weighting, streamed via NDJSON to interactive SVG client charts.

### Project F: ParkControl Sentinel — AI Parking Congestion Intelligence
- **Role**: Full-Stack ML Engineer
- **Domain**: Smart City Infrastructure, Traffic Optimization, Algorithmic Enforcement
- **Live Deployment**: https://gridlock-frontend.vercel.app
- **Source Code**: https://github.com/param20h/Parking-control

- **Architecture Highlights**:

  - Bounded knapsack optimization algorithm for automated police officer dispatch allocation.

### Project G: FlatMate — Shared Expenses Tracker
- **Role**: Backend Developer & Database Designer

- **Live Deployment**: https://spreetail-six.vercel.app/

## 4. Scientific Research & Hackathons

1. **Depression Biomarker Discovery from Speech & Text (DAIC-WOZ Database)**
   - *Methodology*: Applied unsupervised machine learning (PCA dimensionality reduction and K-Means clustering) on the clinical DAIC-WOZ audio-text dataset.
   - *Outcome*: Successfully identified 2 statistically distinct clinical depression subtypes validated against PHQ-8 depression rating scores (chi-square = 6.44, p = 0.0112).
   - *Repository*: https://github.com/param20h/MDD-biomarker-discovery-project

2. **Smart India Hackathon (SIH) 2025: Student Dropout Early Warning System**
   - *Methodology*: Ensemble classification using Random Forest and Logistic Regression trained on 14,000+ academic and socioeconomic student records.
   - *Outcome*: Provided interpretable feature importance rankings allowing mentors to intervene before at-risk students leave the university.
